newsitem.title: USA: Ameriana names chief operating officer. [CORRECTED 22:15 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Ameriana names chief operating officer. [CORRECTED 22:15 GMT]

text.p: Ameriana Bancorp said Monday it named Timothy Clark as executive vice president and chief operating officer of Ameriana Bank.
(Corrects to make clear Clark was named executive vice president and chief operating officer of unit, and not the holding company).

In this newly created position, Clark, 46, will have day-to-day responsibility for the company's banking operations in Indiana. Prior to joining Ameriana, Clark held management positions with National City Bank of Indiana in Seymour, Ind.
Ameriana provides banking and other financial services and has assets of about $402 million.
